audit_opinion_type_taxonomy.question: What is the exact authoritative allowed-category taxonomy for the structured `audit_opinion_type` field, per a CODAL field schema or Iranian Audit Organization / IACPA standard text?
authoritative_routes_attempted: Iranian Audit Organization codified standards (audit.org.ir/WFrmCodificatedStandardView.aspx) - unreachable
IACPA (iacpa.ir) - REACHABLE, but publishes no taxonomy itself; it links out to audit.org.ir, which is unreachable

supporting_evidence_obtained.source: ISA 705 (Revised), Modifications to the Opinion in the Independent Auditor's Report
supporting_evidence_obtained.establishes: ISA 705 (Revised) paragraph 2 establishes exactly three types of modified opinion: a qualified opinion, an adverse opinion, and a disclaimer of opinion; effective for audits of financial statements for periods ending on or after December 15, 2016. Together with an unmodified opinion under ISA 700 (Revised) this yields a four-category opinion structure.
does_not_establish: that the Iranian Audit Organization adopted this taxonomy verbatim (audit.org.ir unreachable)
that CODAL exposes a STRUCTURED audit-opinion field at all
the exact machine-readable category identifiers/values CODAL would use
the Persian term-to-category mapping as encoded by CODAL
supporting_evidence_obtained.not_committed_reason: IFAC copyright requires written permission to reproduce, store or transmit; this repository is public and no such permission exists

audit_opinion_type_taxonomy.why_supporting_evidence_is_insufficient: The frozen Stage125 definition requires the label to be an explicit structured field/value on the official CODAL report, never inferred from free text. An international standard describing opinion types cannot establish either the existence or the allowed value set of a CODAL structured field.
audit_opinion_type_taxonomy.resolution_still_required_before_gate: an authoritative CODAL field schema, or Iranian Audit Organization / IACPA standard text, confirming the exact category identifiers

audit_lag_days_calendar_conversion.question: Is there an authoritative deterministic convention for computing audit_lag_days = audit_report_date - fiscal_year_end, including each field's documented calendar and format, and an authoritative Jalali/Gregorian conversion rule if conversion is required?

substantive_secondary_finding.finding: Available SUPPORTING evidence describes the official Iranian civil calendar as astronomically determined - the year beginning at the midnight nearest the vernal equinox observed at the Iranian reference meridian - rather than governed by a closed-form arithmetic rule such as the repository library's fixed 33-year cycle. Consequently no arithmetic library rule may be ASSUMED to be the authoritative civil calendar without being checked against officially published dates.
substantive_secondary_finding.library_algorithm_observed: date.isleap() returns (year % 33) in (1, 5, 9, 13, 17, 22, 26, 30) - a fixed 33-year arithmetic cycle
substantive_secondary_finding.library_cited_authority: the isleap() docstring cites only http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leap_year
substantive_secondary_finding.library_internal_roundtrip_check: 7304 consecutive Jalali dates (1385-01-01..1404-12-28) round-tripped Jalali->Gregorian->Jalali with 0 mismatches
substantive_secondary_finding.roundtrip_check_interpretation: establishes internal invertibility of the library's own approximation ONLY; it does not establish agreement with the official observational calendar and is not offered as authoritative validation
substantive_secondary_finding.inference_limits: Sufficient to show the library approximation cannot be assumed correct, and therefore to keep this prerequisite BLOCKED. NOT sufficient to positively define the official calendar rule, and not presented as independently resolved authoritative evidence. Establishes no specific divergence in any specific year.

audit_lag_days_calendar_conversion.resolution_still_required_before_gate: authoritative CODAL date-field format documentation, plus an authoritative deterministic calendar-conversion rule validated against officially published Iranian calendar dates
